description:
Stafford Gray is looking for an experienced GIS Analyst with strong development skills to support several complex spatial applications for a public-sector client focused on environmental and natural resource programs. You'll maintain and improve existing web, client/server, and mobile GIS applications. You'll also advise developers on spatial design and work with project managers to keep quality, milestones, and deadlines on track.
 This is a hands-on technical role. You'll do spatial analysis and basemap work, and you'll also write SQL, build ArcGIS Online and Portal apps, and work in a .NET and JavaScript codebase.
 What you'll do 
 Maintain and enhance existing GIS applications across web, desktop, and mobile platforms.
 Build and manage ArcGIS Online and Portal content, including Experience Builder apps and Dashboards.
 Create basemaps, generate tile caches, and perform imagery analysis.
 Write and maintain SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and SSIS packages; manage spatial databases, validate data, and keep metadata current.
 Plan and carry out unit, system, regression, and automated testing.
 Give developers technical guidance on spatial data needs, and serve as a liaison to business stakeholders and outside consultants.
 Assess new technology and recommend solutions to recurring problems.
 Requirements 
 Required qualifications 
 4+ years of experience in GIS, cartography, CADD, or a related field.
 4+ years developing user interfaces, menus, and macro-level commands, along with complex spatial analysis and customer-driven reporting.
 4+ years of ArcGIS Online and Portal experience, including Experience Builder and Dashboards.
 4+ years creating or maintaining geospatial basemaps, including tile caches and imagery analysis.
 4+ years of advanced SQL: scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, SSIS packages, spatial database maintenance, and metadata management.
 4+ years of unit, system, regression, and automated testing.
 2+ years with C#.NET, VB.NET, ASP.NET, XML, AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, T-SQL, and TypeScript.
 Power Apps experience.
 1+ year of working knowledge of ADA/accessibility compliance.
 A bachelor's degree. Foreign degrees are accepted if evaluated as equivalent to a U.S. bachelor's degree.
 Preferred qualifications 
 1+ year with Azure DevOps, Git, Helix, and MS Office.
 1+ year with Angular.
 Location requirement: Candidates must live within 90 miles of Lansing, MI (48933) at the time of submission.
